# SecretPDF

> SecretPDF is an online library of digital PDFs: guides, planners, templates and coloring books you download and print yourself, plus children's coloring books and illustrated story books.

## What SecretPDF sells

Each product is a PDF file. After payment the file is available to download straight away; nothing is shipped. You can print the file at home as many times as you need. Each file is fingerprinted to the purchase.

## Categories

- Study & Exam: https://secretpdf.co/category/study
- Business & Templates: https://secretpdf.co/category/business
- Wellness & Mind: https://secretpdf.co/category/wellness
- Fitness & Meal Plans: https://secretpdf.co/category/fitness
- Parenting & Kids: https://secretpdf.co/category/parenting
- Coloring Books: https://secretpdf.co/category/coloring-books
- Lifestyle & Planners: https://secretpdf.co/category/lifestyle
- Art & Creative: https://secretpdf.co/category/creative
- Cooking & Recipes: https://secretpdf.co/category/cooking

## Kids

The kids section (https://secretpdf.co/kids) has printable coloring books and illustrated story books for children.

## How buying works

1. Find a PDF in the library (https://secretpdf.co/library) or by category (https://secretpdf.co/categories).
2. Check out and pay. Paddle is the Merchant of Record for orders.
3. Download the file from your account and print it.

## Refunds

SecretPDF offers a 30-day money-back guarantee on purchases. Refunds are handled by Paddle. Details: https://secretpdf.co/refund-policy

## Company and contact

SecretPDF is operated by Sandking Company Limited. Contact: support@secretpdf.co. Privacy questions: privacy@secretpdf.co.
